state.user_prompt: Summarize the following tweets about Christmas in 5 sentences. Just tell me what normal people think about Christmas; most of these tweets say the same thing anyway, and the odd ones out don’t really represent anyone. Keep it simple.
state.summary: Most people feel that the end of Christmas marks the true beginning of their real lives, often expressed through relief at taking down decorations and returning to work. Many express a mix of gratitude for gifts received alongside humorous complaints about gaining weight or dealing with leftover wrapping paper. The holiday season is frequently associated with family gatherings, watching movies, and spending time with friends, even if some relationships are strained. A common sentiment among the tweets is missing the break itself, as people look forward to resuming their normal routines after the festivities. Ultimately, while experiences vary from joyous celebrations to awkward social situations, the general consensus is that Christmas brings a unique blend of happiness and exhaustion.
